newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures edge off, late trade light.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures edge off, late trade light.

text.p: April 17 - IMM currency futures edged back off late, still mixed in light afternoon trade. Some said ability of June T-bonds to keep the bulk of gains, firmness in U.S. stocks, slightly weighed on currencies. They glossed over remarks by Kansas City Fed president Hoenig, who said Fed has "obligation" to preserve value of dollar. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
